messages:
maria_cs: ACME reports that after OneLogin SCIM sync yesterday (~2026-02-12 20:05 UTC) ~22 users lost the 'Platform Admin' role in our UI. OneLogin shows ~20 members in the group but our system reports 0. They attached a provisioning log excerpt. Can we triage? (cc @ryan_se @dan_engineering)

ryan_se: thanks — can you paste the provisioning log snippet and their current group-to-role mapper config? sounds like a member identifier mismatch.

maria_cs: pasted below (from customer). They said OneLogin switched export format recently. Log snippet:

```json
{
  "groupId": "g-12345",
  "displayName": "Platform Admin",
  "members": [
    {"value": "alice@acme.com", "type": "user"},
    {"value": "bob@acme.com", "type": "user"}
  ]
}
```

Their mapping currently expects `members[].id` (SCIM `id`) but OneLogin is only sending `value` with email addresses.

ryan_se: yep that's the mismatch — our SCIM mapper historically reads `members[].id`. If the Ids are missing and `value` contains email, group membership resolves to zero. Quick mitigations: ask the customer to enable the `id` field in OneLogin, or update their mapper in our UI. Longer term we should tolerate `members[].value` as fallback. @dan_engineering any appetite for a defensive change?

dan_engineering: we have a small fallback on dev where we try `members[].value` if no ids matched, but it's not in prod. For triage: we can do an adhoc reconcile that matches by email to re-link users. Example command (one-time):

```bash
# one-time: map emails to user ids and reassign role
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/internal/provisioning/reconcile \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"groupId":"g-12345","members":["alice@acme.com","bob@acme.com"]}'
```

olivia_sre: i'll run the reconcile in dry-run mode first and sanity-check. also please get explicit consent from the customer to operate on PII (emails). @maria_cs can you confirm?

maria_cs: customer okayed dry-run and prefers to change their connector, but asked for a fallback on our side in case they swap providers again.

scim-bot: EVENT webhook: scim:group:members_changed groupId=g-12345 timestamp=2026-02-12T20:05:12Z

dan_engineering: proposed plan: 1) run reconcile dry-run and verify 22 users map correctly; 2) ship a small defensive fallback to accept `members[].value` when `members[].id` is absent — canary it; 3) add an alert for sudden group membership drops; 4) docs/UI hint for SCIM mappers. I'll open a PR.

ryan_se: also log the exact payload shape we got from OneLogin to analytics so we can catch provider-specific quirks in future.

dan_engineering: will add telemetry on group_sync failures where `members` present but no ids matched.

maria_cs: customer satisfied for now; asked for ETA on the config fallback PR.

dan_engineering: PR #4521 opened, target canary 2026-02-13 03:00 UTC. i'll update thread once canary passes.

maria_cs: thanks all :thumbsup:
